name: anima-mcp
description: Give your AI agents real-world capabilities: email inboxes, phone numbers, SMS, voice calls, custom domains, webhooks, and an encrypted credential vault. 58 tools for autonomous agent operations.

tools.name: account_overview
tools.description: Single-call workspace snapshot: organization context, credential identity, send-capability flags (canSendEmail / canSendSms), inventory counts (agents, domains, phones), and active blockers.

tools.name: agent_create
tools.description: Create a new agent with optional metadata, and optionally attach an initial address.

tools.name: agent_delete
tools.description: Delete an agent by ID.

tools.name: agent_get
tools.description: Fetch full detail for a single agent by ID: settings, metadata, status, and the full addresses[] / emailIdentities[] / phoneIdentities[] lists.

tools.name: agent_list
tools.description: List agents in the current account context with cursor pagination.

tools.name: agent_update
tools.description: Update an agent's name or metadata, and/or add/update/delete an address.

tools.name: domain_create
tools.description: Register a custom sending domain in the workspace so it can be configured for email traffic.

tools.name: domain_delete
tools.description: Delete a domain from the workspace when it is no longer needed.

tools.name: domain_get
tools.description: Fetch full detail for a single domain by ID, including verification and configuration state.

tools.name: domain_list
tools.description: List every domain connected to the current workspace (unpaginated).

tools.name: domain_update
tools.description: Update mutable configuration on a domain.

tools.name: domain_verify
tools.description: Trigger a verification check for a domain after DNS records are configured.

tools.name: domain_zone_file
tools.description: Get the full DNS zone file for a domain.

tools.name: email_attachment_get
tools.description: Get a temporary download URL for an email attachment.

tools.name: email_draft_create
tools.description: Create a new email draft (composed but not sent).

tools.name: email_draft_delete
tools.description: Discard a draft.

tools.name: email_draft_get
tools.description: Fetch full detail for a single draft by ID.

tools.name: email_draft_list
tools.description: List email drafts with optional filters.

tools.name: email_draft_send
tools.description: Send a draft.

tools.name: email_forward
tools.description: Forward an existing email to another recipient by loading the original content first.

tools.name: email_get
tools.description: Fetch full detail for a single email by ID, including metadata and body.

tools.name: email_list
tools.description: List emails with cursor pagination, optionally scoped to one agent.

tools.name: email_reply
tools.description: Reply to an existing email thread by first loading the original message and setting threading headers.

tools.name: email_search
tools.description: Search email by MEANING (default) or by literal keyword.

tools.name: email_send
tools.description: Send a new outbound email from the agent mailbox.

tools.name: email_thread_get
tools.description: Fetch all email messages in one or more threads.

tools.name: phone_call_create
tools.description: Initiate an outbound phone call from an agent (REST-style: returns a callId immediately).

tools.name: phone_call_get
tools.description: Get full detail for a single phone call: status, duration, participants, tier, AI-generated summary (one-liner, topics, action items, decisions, open questions, next steps), and quality score.

tools.name: phone_call_list
tools.description: List phone calls with optional filters.

tools.name: phone_call_recording_get
tools.description: Get a time-limited download URL for a call recording (WAV format).

tools.name: phone_call_transcript_get
tools.description: Get the full transcript of a phone call with speaker labels, timestamps, and confidence scores.

tools.name: phone_number_list
tools.description: List provisioned phone numbers, optionally filtered by agent.

tools.name: phone_number_provision
tools.description: Provision a new phone number from the carrier pool and assign it to an agent.

tools.name: phone_number_release
tools.description: Release a previously provisioned phone number back to the carrier pool.

tools.name: provisioning_request_cancel
tools.description: Withdraw a pending request you no longer need, so your owner is not left deciding something nobody wants.

tools.name: provisioning_request_create
tools.description: Ask your human owner to provision a vault or a phone number for you.

tools.name: provisioning_request_list
tools.description: List provisioning requests you have filed and their current status.

tools.name: provisioning_request_status
tools.description: Check one provisioning request.

tools.name: sms_get
tools.description: Fetch full detail for a single SMS by ID (includes its `threadId` for joining the conversation).

tools.name: sms_list
tools.description: List SMS messages with optional filters.

tools.name: sms_send
tools.description: Send an SMS to a phone number, or an MMS by passing `mediaUrls`.

tools.name: sms_thread_get
tools.description: Get a specific SMS conversation with message history.

tools.name: sms_thread_list
tools.description: List SMS conversations.

tools.name: usage_overview
tools.description: Usage rollup for a billing period.

tools.name: vault_credential_create
tools.description: Create a new credential in an agent vault.

tools.name: vault_credential_delete
tools.description: Delete a credential from vault storage by ID.

tools.name: vault_credential_get
tools.description: Get a single vault credential by ID.

tools.name: vault_credential_get_totp
tools.description: Get the current TOTP code for a credential that has a TOTP secret configured.

tools.name: vault_credential_list
tools.description: List every credential in an agent vault.

tools.name: vault_credential_search
tools.description: Search vault credentials by keyword across names and content.

tools.name: vault_credential_update
tools.description: Update an existing vault credential by ID.

tools.name: vault_provision
tools.description: Provision a credential vault for an agent.

tools.name: voice_list
tools.description: List available AI voices for placing phone calls.

tools.name: webhook_delete
tools.description: Delete a webhook subscription by ID.

tools.name: webhook_get
tools.description: Get a webhook subscription by ID.

tools.name: webhook_list
tools.description: List webhook subscriptions for the calling org with cursor pagination.

tools.name: webhook_set
tools.description: Create or update a webhook subscription.

tools.name: webhook_test
tools.description: Send a test event payload to a webhook to verify the endpoint is reachable and the signature verification on the receiver side works.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your Anima agent API key (ak_...). Create one at https://console.useanima.sh, or run `am init`.

master_key.title: Master Key (optional)
master_key.description: Org master key (mk_...). Only needed for admin tools such as agent_delete and domain management. Leave blank otherwise.
